info.description: X is on the loose in London and the detectives must work together to find this elusive character.
info.similarDesigner: Manfred Burggraf, Dorothy Garrels, Wolf Hoermann, Fritz Ifland, Werner Scheerer, Werner Schlegelempty
info.helpText:
Decide which player will be "X". That player sits in the top/first seat. Other players take as many seats as necessary to fill the slots based on the desired rules (default rules requires all seats to be taken).

Click the reset button in the upper left corner. If using default rules, player tokens will be randomly distributed on the board in one of 18 designated starting spaces and tickets will be distributed to each seat.

Many alternative rule sets exist. Some require a few extra widgets. If using the variant options from https://boardgamegeek.com/filepage/26406/variantspdf, those widgets are available in the left center in Hyde Park by checking the box during setup.

X goes first. X's marker is displayed on the board, but only X can see it. X should always move the marker first, then pay the ticket. The new space is automatically recorded under the ticket. When X is required to reveal their location, X has a button only visible to X to click to make that happen. Clicking it again hides X's marker.

When the remaining detective players use a ticket, they should drop it into X's piles. It does not matter if they move first or pay the ticket first.

Click the "flash" icon in the upper right to briefly highlight the location of markers on the board. This will not reveal X's location to anyone except for the X player.

You can show or hide routes by color by clicking on the checkmarks in the box in the upper left in Regent's Park.

Player cursors are hidden in the room. If you want to demonstrate something to another player, use the arrow next to the turn button by dragging it around.

fields.text: For use by X to set bomb

To set the bomb (indicated by the letter 'B' on the log entry), double-click the ticket after you have used it. The counter on this button will increase by 1. Only X can see this button once it is clicked.
For use by X to pick a random location to visit
To generate a location, click Go. If the location is reached and X decides to continue, press the button again for another random location. Only X can see this button once it is clicked.
